description: Night-time street-level photograph of the Corinthia Hotel in London, its curved corner facade lit up, viewed across a road with blurred passing cars. A lit sign over the entrance reads 'CORINTHIA HOTEL'. Ornate stone buildings and street lamps line the left side; the image has large black letterboxing above and below, consistent with a phone screenshot. Filename 'CH3.PNG' is consistent with 'Corinthia Hotel'.

Screenshot of a TinEye reverse image search results page showing '0 results' for an uploaded file named 'chk.png'. The search thumbnail is the same letterboxed night photograph of the Corinthia Hotel in London attached to Q post 2798. A zero-result TinEye search is commonly offered as evidence that a photo is original and not previously published online; the screenshot itself only shows the search outcome.
text: TinEye. Upload or enter Image URL. 0 results. Searched over 34.7 billion images for: chk.png. Using TinEye is private. We do not save your search images. TinEye is free to use for non-commercial purposes. For business solutions, learn about our technology.
flags: The implication that a zero-result search proves the photo is original is a claim, not established fact

description: Simple black-and-white clip-art style icon of a spy: a black silhouette figure in a wide-brimmed hat and high-collared trench coat with narrowed white eyes, on a white background. Generic stock-style graphic; filename is 'Spy.png'.

Annotated Google Street View screenshot (2012 Google watermarks) of Victoria Embankment at the Golden Jubilee / Hungerford Bridge footbridge stairs by Embankment, London — the white cable-stayed bridge pylons and an 'Ocean Leisure' shop sign are visible, with vans, a red London taxi and a blue classic Mini in traffic. A hand-drawn red circle marks a camera or lamp fixture on a pole near the bridge stairway, with a red arrow drawn from it across the road toward the far corner, apparently indicating that camera's line of sight. This location is adjacent to the Corinthia Hotel photo discussed in the surrounding Q posts.
flags: The red annotation's meaning (camera vantage point) is inferred from the drawing, not stated in the image
Pedestrians and drivers are anonymous private individuals

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2681 (tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCI, ID aoc52d, No.5101092, Feb 9 2019) — a bracketed countdown/checklist-style post. All listed items are the drop's claims, not established facts.
